answer: A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The zenith counter is kept in pearl and nebula shows each reset. Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 583 identities would post 4205 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
